DMV: Appointments needed now at all DMV State Locations 
read more 
REGISTRATION RENEWALS 
In person:  Bring the expiring registration or the online renewal info (you may send a “courier” to renew a vehicle for you, they must bring the expiring registration along with an ID) 
Online:   you need your plate # and last 4 digits of VIN# from your registration.  Pay Online Here 
By mail:  send the renewal info, a check, or money order made out to the “Town of Stratford” for the total of your transaction (call or look up online). Please include a SASE. 
_____________________________________________________________________________ 
NEW RESIDENTS 
Moved from another NH town/city:  Bring your expiring registration, ID, and proof of residency 
Moved from Out-of-State:  Bring the out-of-state title and registration, ID, and proof of residency. If a lienholder has the title then bring the lienholder contact information. All vehicle owners listed on the title must be present to sign the NH Title Application! 
The State of NH requires that vehicles are titled and registered within 60 days of establishing residency. You do not need a New Hampshire Driver’s License to complete this process. 
______________________________________________________________________________ 
TITLE AND REGISTER A NEWLY OWNED VEHICLE 
Newly owned vehicles are titled and registered in person at the Town Clerk’s Office 
Vehicles 2000 and newer: 
Title Application completed by a licensed NH dealer. 
or 
If this is a private sale, a current title is properly filled out and signed by the seller(s) and buyer(s). All buyers must be present to complete a private sale title application unless you can present a notarized  Power of Attorney Form . 
For sales from out-of-state dealers, please contact Town Clerk for further info. 
Vehicles 1999 and older: 
VIN Verification needed by one of the following
Copy of a prior title 
Copy of prior NH registration 
VIN Verification Form  ( TDMV19A ) 
PLUS:  Bill of sale 
___________________________________________________________________________ 
PLATE TRANSFERS 
Plate transfers are done in person at the Town Clerk’s Office. 
Transfers must keep the same primary owner. 
Must bring current registration from prior vehicle. If you do not have the current ORIGINAL registration, you can purchase a certified copy for $18. 
_________________________________________________________________________ 
TEMPORARY PLATES 
NH 20-Day Temporary Plates for private sales are issued at the DMV ONLY. ______________________________________________________________________________ 
MOTORCYCLES 
Motorcycles are titled and registered the same as vehicles. See above. 
Moped 50cc and under: Initial registration is handled with the DMV, after that renewals can be done as usual at the Town Clerk’s Office. Mopeds are not titled in NH. 
_________________________________________________________________________ 
TRAILERS 
Trailers are titled and registered the same as vehicles. See above. 
Trailers with a GVW (Gross Vehicle Weight) of 3000 pounds or less are title exempt and just need a Bill of Sale – including the VIN number! – to register. If new, bring a Certificate of Origin from the dealer. 
_________________________________________________________________________ 
VETERAN PLATES 
Veteran plates can now be issued directly at the Town Clerk’s Office, you do not need to go to the DMV any more. For first time plate issues, please bring proof of your veteran status (such as form DD 214) and complete the nescessary paperwork at the office. Once established, you can renew your veteran plates just like any other NH license plate. 
_________________________________________________________________________ 
If you have any further questions, please contact the Town Clerk’s Office. 
The Stratford Town Clerk is a Boat Agent for the State of NH. We’re happy to register your boat for you. 
Boat Registration Renewals  can be done in person or by mail. Please add $5 agent fee to the DMV renewal amount on your letter. ( There currently is no online renewal option for boat registrations) . 
In Person:  at the Town Clerk’s Office 
By Mail:  Include Bow Number & Return Address 
Make out check to “Town of Stratford” 
Mail to : Town of Stratford, P.O. Box 366, Stratford, NH 03590 
PAY ONLINE 
State Law,  RSA 466:1  requires that all dogs be licensed EACH YEAR between January 1st and  April 30th . Puppies must be licensed promptly after their first rabies inoculation. From May 1st on, a late fee of $1 per month will be automatically charged for any licenses issued after the April deadline. 
In order to license their dog(s) owners must show proof of current rabies vaccination.  
2026 Vaccination Clinic April 4 & 26 at Second Chance Animal Rescue 
Dog Licensing Fees 
Male or Female – Unaltered  $9.00 
Spayed/Neutered Dog  $6.50 
1st Dog owned by a Senior citizen (65+)  $2.00 
Puppies (3-7 months)  $6.50 
Group/Kennel Licenses (5+ dogs)  $20.00 
  How can I license my dog?   
  Online  (pay online here)  – renewals only, rabies vaccination must be current in our records 
  In person  at the Town Clerk’s Office 
  By Mail :  Send check made out to “Town of Stratford” to: Stratford Town Clerk, PO Box 366, Stratford NH 03590 
You can also register and license a new dog by mail ( get form here ) 
Please contact the Town Clerk with any further questions. 
Election Information & Voter Registration 
2026 ELECTIONS: 
State Primary Election : Tuesday, September 8, 2026 at Fuller Town Hall 10 AM-7 PM   Check out the Election Results here!   
State General Election : Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at Fuller Town Hall 10 AM-7 PM 
Note: On Mondays preceding any election the Clerk’s office will be open from 3-5 pm to receive absentee ballots. 
Polls in Stratford are always open from 10 am to 7 pm on Election Days .  IDs are now mandatory for all voters! 
New Voter Registration 
Residents may register to vote anytime during the year with the Town Clerk during regular business hours. 
New Hampshire also allows “Same day registration” on the day of election. 
If you are registering as a new voter you need: a photo ID, proof of citizenship, age and primary residency in Stratford. Visit the  NH State Election website  for more information on these requirements. 
You can check your voter status with NH Secretary of State’s office  Voter Look up  
Absentee Ballot Applications 
Absentee ballots are available from the Town Clerk. Fill out application completely and mail or drop off at Town Clerk’s Office. Ballots will be mailed out as soon as they are available. Please note: each election requires a separate application! 
2026 Absentee Ballot Application – Town Election 
2026 Absentee Ballot Application – State Election 
Political Parties 
When registering to vote, you do not have to register as a member of a political party (republican or democratic) – you may register as an undeclared voter. Undeclared voters may declare a party and vote at any primary. The law allows an undeclared voter to declare a party at the polls, vote the ballot of that party, and then change their party affiliation back to ‘undeclared’ simply by filling out a form with the  Supervisors of the Checklist  before leaving the polling place. Voters can also change their party affiliation at the Town Clerk’s Office. Certain deadlines apply before each primary election when a voter cannot change their party affiliation. 
If you are unsure of your party affiliation, you can check your voter status with NH Secretary of State’s office  Voter Look up  or contact the Town Clerk’s Office. 
For more information on elections, including how to register to vote, visit the  NH Secretary of State Elections Site. 
The Stratford Town Clerk’s Office can supply certified copies of Vital Records for events that occurred in New Hampshire. 
Please note:  Certified Vital Records (unless they’re historical) can be issued by any  NH Town Clerk – so if it’s more convenient to get your record in a different Town office, feel free to do so.  
Ways to apply for a Certified Copy of a Vital Record: 
In Person:  at the Town Clerk’s Office 
You will need to show a Photo ID & fill out an application 
By Mail:  please contact Clerk for information on how to proceed 
Fees: 
Certified copies of birth, death, civil union, marriage, divorce, dissolution: $15 
Subsequent copies: $10* 
Please note:  The $15 fee is a search fee, payable whether or not the record is found 
 *Reduced fee for subsequent copies only if issued at same time as first copy. 
A marriage license can only be issued in person. Both parties need to be present. 
This service is by appointment only – please contact the Town Clerk. 
Bring : Photo ID. If this is not your first marriage, the  original copy  of the latest occurrence of death, annulment or divorce. You will also need information on parents’ names, their names at birth, and birth dates (your own birth certificate can help if you are not sure). 
Once issued, the license is valid for 90 days. 
Please note:  Marriage Licenses can be issued by any  NH Town Clerk – so if it’s more convenient to get your license in a different Town office, feel free to do so.  
Fee:  Marriage License: $50 
The Stratford Town Clerk is a certified Notary Public. The Town office also has a Justice of the Peace staff member available. 
These services are available during our regular business hours.  
The service fee is $1.00 per notarization.
